title: Expected breaker failures, year by year
heading: Count Expected Failures When a Failed Asset Is Repaired and Kept
cases: a single new breaker's expected failures in its first year is its cumulative hazard at age 1
every breaker is one year older in each later year
a repaired breaker can fail more than once a year, so the expected count can exceed one per breaker
the chance of no failure is that of a breaker working today
